OmaCal is now Calendar for Omarchy. Installs keep updating as before, and calendar feeds can no longer get past the download limit.

![Calendar for Omarchy's calendar and quick-add form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omarchy-calendar/v1.2.1/preview.png)

## New

- **A new name: Calendar for Omarchy.** OmaCal was also the name of [x3me's OmaCal app](https://omacal.app), so the plugin is renamed to keep the two apart. The repository moved to [crmne/omarchy-calendar](https://github.com/crmne/omarchy-calendar), and the old address redirects there. The plugin id is still `crmne.omacal`, so existing installs, settings, feeds and the bar's layout stay as they are, and searching for "omacal" in the bar's widget list still finds it. By @crmne; thanks @jondkinney for raising it in [#5](https://github.com/crmne/omarchy-calendar/issues/5).

## Fixed

- **Calendar feeds stay within the 20 MiB limit, even when they redirect.** A feed address that redirected could send an unlimited amount of data first, because Python reads a redirect's whole response before following it. Calendar for Omarchy now skips that response. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux for finding it in [marketplace #11988](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace/issues/11988).

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omarchy-calendar.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

## Thanks
